svg.aria-label: The problem: top-deck one card you chose
svg.title: The problem: top-deck one card you chose
svg.text: The problem: top-deck one card you chose
Catching the Power Nut = drawing your chosen card off a deck of 51 that reshuffles every frame (1/30 s).
Your card is on top on 5 of these 60 frames, and on 22 of 1,197 in the first 40 s: a blind draw gets it 1.8% of the time.
Each cast shuffles a new card in; leaving the beach gives a new deck; and while you fish the deck shuffles faster.
draw now: 0.72 s after Jack stops
The tool watches the dog to know which deck you hold and how far it has shuffled,
and counts you down to the frames where your card is on top.
Real data: L1 of Sunny → No horse (14% of arrivals), cast frames after READY; goal card = a cast that lands the Nut on the 1st bite.
